notes.title: Lara Croft Go swings to a proper PC release
notes.notes: Lara Croft Go [official site, the tomb-raiding puzzle game spin-off in the same turn-based vein as Hitman Go, finally has a proper PC release. While I was off on my hols scrambling up hills and round waterfalls last week, she arrived on Steam doing much the same. John is a big fan of it on Android so coo, I’ll have to check out this Alice copycat’s antics. I wonder if she also gets vertigo and clings cussing to safety railings. … [visit site to read more]
